name: PR2974 Intel strip comparison

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - codex/pr2974-intel-strip-comparison

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pr2974-intel-strip-comparison
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  compare:
    name: One original Intel none and symbols pair
    runs-on: macos-15-intel
    timeout-minutes: 75
    env:
      INTEL_HARNESS: ${{ github.workspace }}/harness
      INTEL_SOURCE: ${{ github.workspace }}/source
      INTEL_EXPERIMENT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/pr2974-intel-strip-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact runner
        uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          path: harness
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout frozen investigated source
        uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          path: source
          ref: 9d37172d6bc1e1febeb9c7611a5a050ef5ea798a
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405
        with:
          python-version: 3.12.10
      - name: Select uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39
        with:
          version: 0.9.26
          enable-cache: false
      - name: Execute frozen diagnostic pair once
        id: pair
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: python -I -B "$INTEL_HARNESS/ci/pr2974_intel_strip_comparison/entry.py" validate
      - name: Emit complete bounded original report projection
        id: projection
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: python -I -B "$INTEL_HARNESS/ci/pr2974_intel_strip_comparison/entry.py" projection
      - name: Retain all original reports
        id: reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: pr2974-intel-strip-original-reports-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ env.INTEL_EXPERIMENT_ROOT }}/reports/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Retain full binary wheel source and environment archives
        id: originals
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: pr2974-intel-strip-complete-originals-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ env.INTEL_EXPERIMENT_ROOT }}/artifacts/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Require original gates and complete retention
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          PAIR_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.pair.outcome }}
          PROJECTION_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.projection.outcome }}
          REPORT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.reports.outcome }}
          ORIGINAL_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.originals.outcome }}
        run: |
          python -I -B - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          terminal = Path(os.environ["INTEL_EXPERIMENT_ROOT"]) / "reports/terminal.json"
          outcomes = [os.environ[name] for name in (
              "PAIR_OUTCOME", "PROJECTION_OUTCOME", "REPORT_OUTCOME", "ORIGINAL_OUTCOME")]
          assert all(value == "success" for value in outcomes), outcomes
          assert terminal.is_file(), "Missing original terminal receipt"
          result = json.loads(terminal.read_bytes())
          assert result["passed"] is True, result.get("failures")
          assert result["qualification_complete"] is False
          assert result["production_candidate_eligible"] is False
          PY
